latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of x-search.

- Search X (Twitter) posts using the xAI Grok API with real-time access.
- Supports filtering and excluding specific handles, date range, and image/video understanding.
- Results include readable summaries with post content, author info, and citations.
- Requires an xAI API key and Python 3 for setup.
